_doc: Planted articles. `plant` must surface in the top-k for the persona; `lookalikes` share the persona's keywords but are about something else and must not. published_at is relative to the snapshot's frozen_now. Ids are prefixed n- and never collide with corpus ids.

plant.title: NJ Transit to suspend Morris & Essex line service from Newark Penn for two weeks of track work
plant.summary: NJ Transit said Morris & Essex trains will not stop at Newark Penn Station for 14 days starting Monday; riders are told to use PATH or shuttle buses.
plant.content: NJ Transit announced Friday that Morris and Essex line service through Newark Penn Station will be suspended for two weeks beginning Monday while crews replace switches and overhead wire. Riders will be directed to shuttle buses and PATH trains. The agency said monthly pass holders will receive a credit. Commuter groups criticised the short notice.
plant.why: directly disrupts the reader's daily commute

plant.title: Devils trade first-round pick for Jets goaltender Hellebuyck in blockbuster deal
plant.summary: The New Jersey Devils acquired Connor Hellebuyck from Winnipeg for a 2027 first-round pick and a prospect, the team confirmed.
plant.content: The New Jersey Devils have acquired goaltender Connor Hellebuyck from the Winnipeg Jets in exchange for a 2027 first-round pick and prospect Seamus Casey, the club announced. General manager Tom Fitzgerald called it the most significant move of his tenure. Hellebuyck is expected to start the season opener.
plant.why: major news about a named must-cover team

plant.title: MAS proposes new capital rules for Singapore payment firms holding customer funds
plant.summary: The Monetary Authority of Singapore opened consultation on rules requiring licensed payment institutions to hold safeguarded funds in segregated trust accounts.
plant.content: The Monetary Authority of Singapore on Tuesday published a consultation paper proposing that major payment institutions safeguard customer funds in trust accounts at Singapore banks and hold additional capital buffers. The rules would take effect in 2027. Fintech firms have until November to respond.
plant.why: fintech regulation at the reader's own regulator

plant.title: PostgreSQL 19 released with built-in logical replication failover and async I/O
plant.summary: The PostgreSQL Global Development Group released version 19, adding asynchronous I/O for sequential scans and automatic failover of logical replication slots.
plant.content: PostgreSQL 19 is out. Headline features include an asynchronous I/O subsystem that the project says speeds sequential scans by up to 2x on cloud storage, synchronized logical replication slot failover, and incremental backup improvements. Major cloud providers said managed offerings will follow within weeks.
plant.why: core database news for a backend engineer

plant.title: Kazakhstan reintroduces customs duties on Chinese trucks transiting to Central Asia
plant.summary: Kazakhstan's finance ministry will levy a 12% duty on Chinese heavy trucks transiting to Uzbekistan and Tajikistan from October, ending a two-year exemption.
plant.content: Kazakhstan will reinstate a 12 percent customs duty on Chinese heavy goods vehicles transiting its territory toward Uzbekistan and Tajikistan from October 1, the finance ministry said. Freight forwarders warned that trucking rates on the Khorgos to Dushanbe corridor could rise by a fifth. The exemption was introduced in 2024 to boost transit trade.

plant.title: Bank of England cuts rates to 3.75% as inflation falls to target
plant.summary: The Bank of England lowered its base rate by a quarter point, its third cut this year, citing inflation back at 2%.
plant.content: The Bank of England cut interest rates to 3.75 percent on Thursday, the third reduction this year, after inflation returned to its 2 percent target. Mortgage lenders said tracker rates would fall immediately. The Bank signalled further cuts if growth stays weak.

plant.title: Scientists confirm first detection of biosignature gases on exoplanet K2-18b
plant.summary: A James Webb telescope team reports a 5-sigma detection of dimethyl sulfide in the atmosphere of K2-18b.
plant.content: Astronomers using the James Webb Space Telescope report a statistically robust detection of dimethyl sulfide, a gas produced on Earth only by living organisms, in the atmosphere of the exoplanet K2-18b. Independent teams urged caution but called the result the strongest hint of life beyond Earth so far.
plant.why: genuinely interesting science for a broad reader

plant.title: Magnitude 7.8 earthquake strikes off Japan, tsunami warning issued for Pacific coast
plant.summary: A major earthquake hit off northeastern Japan; authorities ordered coastal evacuations and warned of waves up to three metres.
plant.content: A magnitude 7.8 earthquake struck off the coast of Miyagi prefecture at 6:12 a.m. local time, the Japan Meteorological Agency said. Tsunami warnings were issued for the Pacific coast of Honshu and Hokkaido, with waves up to three metres expected. Trains and flights were halted. Early reports described building damage in Sendai.

plant.title: Ontario approves 2 GW of new solar under revised procurement, largest in province's history
plant.summary: Ontario's energy regulator approved contracts for 2 gigawatts of solar capacity, more than doubling the province's installed base.
plant.content: Ontario's Independent Electricity System Operator awarded contracts for two gigawatts of new solar generation on Thursday, the largest clean-energy procurement in the province's history. Developers must reach commercial operation by 2029. The solar industry association called it a turning point for the sector in Canada.

plant.content: President Shavkat Mirziyoyev signed a decree on Monday raising the annual limit on free conversion of Uzbek som to foreign currency to the equivalent of $50,000 and abolishing the remaining residency registration requirements. Economists called it the most significant liberalisation since 2017.

plant.title: Iran reopens Strait of Hormuz to tankers under UN-brokered 72-hour truce; Brent falls 6%
plant.summary: Tanker traffic resumed through Hormuz on day three of the conflict after a UN-brokered pause; Brent crude dropped to $94.
plant.content: Tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz resumed on Wednesday under a 72-hour truce brokered by the United Nations, three days after US strikes on Iranian launchers halted shipping. Brent crude fell 6 percent to $94 a barrel. Analysts said the truce is fragile and that Gulf producers are still routing cargoes around the Cape.

plant.title: Germany triggers gas emergency plan early-warning stage as LNG prices spike on Hormuz closure

plant.content: Germany's economy ministry activated the early-warning stage of its national gas emergency plan on Thursday, citing a 30 percent rise in European LNG prices since the Hormuz closure. The stage involves closer monitoring but no rationing. Industry groups called for a temporary suspension of the gas storage levy.

plant.title: NEA issues haze advisory as PSI enters unhealthy range in eastern Singapore

plant.content: The National Environment Agency issued a haze advisory on Friday afternoon after the 24-hour Pollutant Standards Index reached 110 in eastern Singapore, including Tampines and Pasir Ris. People with asthma and other respiratory conditions were advised to limit outdoor activity. MOH said polyclinics would extend hours.
